summary: Iran experienced multiple missile launches and explosions across Hormozgan and Khuzestan provinces, including a launcher strike in Sirik and massive coastal explosions. Israel's leadership is fractured, with Netanyahu and IDF Chief Zamir clashing over an operation risking war with Iran while Netanyahu threatens disproportionate retaliation against Iranian election interference. Hezbollah operates armed Hermes-900 drones over Beirut and UH-60 helicopters move toward northern Israel, while West Bank violence continues with two gunmen killed after a deadly Hebron checkpoint attack.
key_points: Missile launched from Kuhestak toward Strait of Hormuz in Hormozgan Province, Iran at 2111Z. (Source: @shin_persian/11535)
Netanyahu and IDF Chief of Staff Zamir in unprecedented clash over operation risking war with Iran; Zamir demands full discussion and legal sign-off before acting. (Source: @shin_persian/11528)
Netanyahu at Arrow battery states intelligence indicates Iran and proxies may attack to disrupt Israeli elections, warns of disproportionate response. (Source: @amitsegal/66146)

Multiple massive explosions heard from sea side in coastal Hormozgan at 2119Z; launcher hit in Sirik, Hormozgan; explosion in Ahvaz, Khuzestan at 1950Z. (Source: @shin_persian/11536, @shin_persian/11540, @shin_persian/11537)
Saudi Hercules military transport plane landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran per Iran's Sepah News. (Source: @shin_persian/11532)

US officials report Iran may seek to kill US ambassadors in Middle East and American officials on US soil; CENTCOM plans expanded bombing targets including Iranian energy infrastructure. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8888, @Faytuks_Network/8887)

Hezbollah Hermes-900 armed with 8 silent missiles flying over southern Beirut suburbs since noon; UH-60 Black Hawk headed toward northern occupied Palestine; fighter jets heading south. (Source: @redlinkleb/49917, @redlinkleb/49954, @redlinkleb/49919)

Two Palestinian gunmen killed after attacking Hebron checkpoint Friday, killing Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem, wounding three; IDF sealed attackers' homes in Hebron. (Source: @manniefabian/59426, @manniefabian/59425)

sections.executive_summary: Iran faced a series of kinetic events including a missile launch toward the Strait of Hormuz, multiple explosions in Hormozgan and Khuzestan provinces, and a reported launcher strike in Sirik. Simultaneously, Israel's command structure is fractured as Netanyahu and IDF Chief Zamir clash over a pending operation risking war with Iran, while Netanyahu publicly threatens disproportionate strikes against Iranian election interference. Hezbollah maintains persistent armed drone operations over Beirut and helicopter movements toward northern Israel, and West Bank violence persists with a fatal checkpoint attack and ongoing counterterrorism operations.

points: A missile was launched from Kuhestak toward the Strait of Hormuz in Hormozgan Province at 2111Z, indicating possible Iranian military activity or testing near the strategic waterway. (Source: @shin_persian/11535)

Multiple massive explosions were heard from the sea side in the coastal strip of Hormozgan at 00:49 AM local time (2119Z), suggesting possible naval or coastal engagement. (Source: @shin_persian/11536)

A launcher was struck in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, and a separate blast was reported in the same area, indicating targeted strikes on Iranian launch infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/11540, @shin_persian/11538)
An explosion was heard in Zeytoon Karmandi, Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province at 1950Z, adding to the pattern of unexplained detonations across southern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11537)

A Saudi Arabian Hercules military transport aircraft landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran, per Iran's Sepah News, marking a rare visible Saudi-Iran military logistics contact. (Source: @shin_persian/11532)
Iran's leadership believes Trump will order new strikes regardless of US midterm outcomes and is planning contingency scenarios, per AP reporting. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8889)

US intelligence suggests Iran may seek to assassinate US ambassadors in the Middle East and American officials on US soil, prompting CENTCOM to develop expanded target lists including Iranian energy infrastructure and vital economic sites. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8888, @Faytuks_Network/8887)

Prime Minister Netanyahu and IDF Chief of Staff Zamir are in an unprecedented clash over a planned operation that risks war with Iran; Zamir demands full discussion and legal authorization before any action, warning of rapid escalation on the eve of elections. (Source: @shin_persian/11528)
Netanyahu denies the clash with Zamir and claims there is an "attempt to prevent Iran from disrupting the elections in Israel," framing the tension as election security. (Source: @amitsegal/66162)

At an Arrow missile battery, Netanyahu stated Israel has intelligence signs that Iran and its proxies may attempt an attack to disrupt elections, warning: "Don't test us — you will absorb blows without proportion." (Source: @amitsegal/66146)

IDF launched an interceptor missile toward a "suspicious aerial target" over southern Lebanon where troops are operating; no sirens sounded as no threat to civilians was assessed. (Source: @manniefabian/59427)
Yair Golan publicly backed the Chief of Staff's insistence on clear security necessity, strategic purpose, and responsible action plans for any military move. (Source: @N12chat/231713)
Avigdor Lieberman accused the government's conduct of amounting to "treason against the state and security," reflecting deep political fracture over war decisions. (Source: @N12chat/231711)

Trump posted support for Netanyahu: "Vote for Bibi, we must complete the mission we started," while separately stating "there will be no attack on Iran today" and claiming knowledge of Fordow and destruction of three other sites. (Source: @amitsegal/66163, @yediotnews25/136761, @yediotnews25/136754)

Two Palestinian gunmen, Mohammad Jaaba and Firas Jaaba, attacked a checkpoint on the northern outskirts of Hebron on Friday, killing Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem and wounding three other soldiers; both gunmen were shot dead. (Source: @manniefabian/59426, @manniefabian/59425)

IDF sealed the homes of the two Hebron attackers overnight in Hebron, a standard policy step preceding potential demolition for deadly terror attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59425, @manniefabian/59423)

A Palestinian suspect was apprehended in the Ramallah area by Israeli troops acting on Shin Bet intelligence, suspected of planning an "imminent terror attack along a major road." (Source: @manniefabian/59424)
IDF and Shin Bet arrested a suspect in the Benjamin area who intended to carry out an imminent attack on a "central axis," per a joint statement. (Source: @yediotnews25/136755)

Over 220,000 dunams of olive groves have been harvested by Palestinians in the West Bank this season, yielding approximately 22,500 tons of olives and 5,500 liters of oil, across roughly 100 coordinated harvesting sites under IDF protection. (Source: @manniefabian/59425)

The IDF reports that "flashpoints" account for only a few percent of olive-harvesting areas, with the vast majority of coordinated sites proceeding without incident despite settler attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59425)
Israeli forces significantly bolstered West Bank deployments ahead of and during the harvest season to provide protection, thwart terrorism, and prevent clashes. (Source: @manniefabian/59425)
A Hezbollah Hermes-900 armed with eight silent missiles has been flying over the southern Beirut suburbs (Dahiyeh) since noon, with activity still ongoing. (Source: @redlinkleb/49917)
An armed UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter was tracked heading toward northern occupied Palestine (northern Israel) from Lebanese airspace. (Source: @redlinkleb/49954)
Fighter jets were observed heading south, likely from Lebanese or Syrian airspace toward Israel. (Source: @redlinkleb/49919)
Drone activity persists over Beirut and the southern suburbs, with repeated caution alerts issued by monitoring channels. (Source: @redlinkleb/49966, @redlinkleb/49965)
IDF interceptor launch toward a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon where troops are operating indicates active air defense engagement in the sector. (Source: @manniefabian/59427)
No specific messages regarding Syria or Iraq military developments were present in the provided data.

A Saudi Arabian Hercules military transport plane landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran, per Iran's Sepah News, indicating a rare direct Saudi-Iran military aviation contact. (Source: @shin_persian/11532, @shin_persian/11533)

US officials are focused on intelligence suggesting Iran may target US ambassadors in the Middle East and American officials on US soil, implicating Gulf state diplomatic presence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8888)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran is experiencing unexplained kinetic events across multiple provinces — missile launches, coastal explosions, and launcher strikes — suggesting either Israeli sabotage, internal accidents, or Iranian air defense activity. The Netanyahu-Zamir fracture over a pending high-risk operation indicates Israeli decision-making paralysis at a moment when Netanyahu publicly threatens disproportionate retaliation for perceived Iranian election interference. Hezbollah's sustained armed drone presence over Dahiyeh and helicopter movements toward northern Israel signal heightened readiness. CENTCOM's expanded target planning and US warnings of Iranian assassination plots against diplomats point to a broadening confrontation envelope. The West Bank remains a steady attrition zone with lethal checkpoint attacks and preemptive arrests.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's military transport landing in Tehran amid rising tensions represents a notable diplomatic-military channel opening. The US is preparing contingency strikes on Iranian economic infrastructure while warning of Iranian plots against American personnel regionally and domestically. Israel's political leadership is publicly fractured, with opposition figures accusing the government of treasonous conduct over war decisions. Lebanon's airspace sees persistent Hezbollah drone operations and Israeli interceptor activity. No coordinated Arab League or GCC response is evident in the data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The clustering of explosions in Hormozgan (Kuhestak launch, Sirik launcher strike, coastal blasts) and Khuzestan (Ahvaz) within hours suggests a coordinated campaign or cascading failures. The Saudi Hercules flight to Mehrabad may indicate backchannel deconfliction or humanitarian coordination. Trump's contradictory statements — threatening strikes while denying today's attack and claiming Fordow knowledge — reflect strategic ambiguity. The IDF's olive harvest protection data (220k dunams, 100 sites) reveals the scale of West Bank stabilization effort. Hezbollah's Hermes-900 with eight missiles over Dahiyeh demonstrates advanced loitering munition capability in dense urban terrain.
